items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: The interviewee only responds to the interviewer's statement that the interviewer 'told Russell' about the interviewee's past. The interviewee does not mention Russell directly nor describe a personal interaction with him.

ctx.x: Freddie Gould. No, I forgot him. I don't know anything. I think he must be some kinder, Johnny. Yeah, yeah. Must be the young ones that just come up around. Yeah, yeah.
Oh, you told Russell about going to the music stall on Charter Street? Oh, on Charter Street, yeah. And you'd buy those 25-cent music books?
Yeah, books. Yeah, books. Yeah. It'd have sets. 25 sets of books.
